import json, subprocess, sys, os, tempfile
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import fuzz as F
def show(name, cfg, ops):
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        p, err = F.compile_prog(cfg, d)
        assert p, err
        data = F.lines_of(ops).encode()
        rc, out, e = F.run_cmd([F.SUB, "stream", p], data)
        print("###", name)
        for req, line in zip(ops, out.decode().splitlines()):
            print("  req:", json.dumps(req))
            print("  -> :", line)
